actions.observe: Read engine.suggestions exactly once; append exact Suggestion values to flattened capture array in display order. Snapshot before/after, elapsed milliseconds. No forced refresh/reconciliation.
actions.type: For each Swift Character in text: engine.insertCharacter(String(character)); spaces/newlines in text are insertCharacter calls, distinct from explicit space/return actions.
actions.setMode: Load LanguageStack(dictionaryURL: explicit resource directory/<mode>.pkdict, sharing: currentStack); set engine.settings.language; engine.useLanguageStack(newStack). Release old stack.
actions.hostMove: Validate Character caret + selectionLength <= document.count; change concrete document range; call engine.documentDidChange() iff callback.
actions.hostReplace: Validate Character range against supplied full document; replace concrete document and range, optionally create new UUID; call engine.documentDidChange() iff callback. Host operation is recorded separately, never counted as engine primitive.
actions.setPolicy: Fresh InputTraits(capitalization: .none); normal=.standard; private=isSecure true; url=.url; numeric=.numberPad. Assign traits; assign settings.predictions and settings.learnWords. No simulated policy.
actions.acceptSlot: Read engine.suggestions; require indexed actual slot; pass same Suggestion value directly to engine.select. Missing slot is explicit failure, no replacement. Reading here does not append captures.
actions.replayCapturedSlot: Bounds-check flattened observed capture array; engine.select(capturedValue), preserving hidden sourceContext. No reconstruction.

unsupported: direct model prediction or history injection
